ne7:1.5: ajjhosānalakkhaṇā taṇhā, tassā piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:1.8: sāsavaphassa upagamanalakkhaṇā sukhasaññā, tassā assādo padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:1.9: saṅkhatalakkhaṇānaṃ dhammānaṃ asamanupassanalakkhaṇā niccasaññā, tassā viññāṇaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:1.10: aniccasaññā dukkhasaññā asamanupassanalakkhaṇā attasaññā, tassā nāmakāyo padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:1.11: sabbadhammasampaṭivedhalakkhaṇā vijjā, tassā sabbaṃ neyyaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:1.12: cittavikkhepa paṭisaṃharaṇalakkhaṇo samatho, tassa asubhā padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:1.13: icchāvacarapaṭisaṃharaṇalakkhaṇo alobho. tassa adinnādānā veramaṇī padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:1.14: abyāpajjhalakkhaṇo adoso, tassa pāṇātipātā veramaṇī padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:1.15: vatthu avippaṭipādanalakkhaṇo amoho. tassa sammāpaṭipatti padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:1.17: sāsavaphassa parijānanalakkhaṇā dukkhasaññā, tassā vedanā padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:1.18: saṅkhatalakkhaṇānaṃ dhammānaṃ samanupassanalakkhaṇā aniccasaññā, tassā uppādavayā padaṭṭhānaṃ
ne7:1.19: sabbadhammānaṃ abhinivesalakkhaṇā anattasaññā, tassā dhammasaññā padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:2.1: pañcakāmaguṇā kāmarāgassa padaṭṭhānaṃ. pañcindriyāni rūpīni rūparāgassa padaṭṭhānaṃ chaṭṭhāyatanaṃ bhavarāgassa padaṭṭhānaṃ. nibbattibhāvānupassitā pañcannaṃ upādānakkhandhānaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ. pubbenivāsānussati ñāṇadassanassa padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:2.2: okappalakkhaṇā saddhā, adhimuttipaccupaṭṭhānā ca anāvilalakkhaṇo pasādo, saṃpasīdanapaccupaṭṭhāno ca.
ne7:2.3: abhipattiyana lakkhaṇā saddhā, tassā aveccappasādo, padaṭṭhānā.
ne7:3.1: aparo nayo: assādamanasikāralakkhāṇo ayoniso manasikāro, tassa avijjā padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:3.5: nāmakāyarūpakāyasaṅghātalakkhaṇaṃ nāma rūpaṃ, taṃ saḷāyatanassa padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:3.12: khandhānaṃ pātubhavanalakkhaṇā jāti, sā jarāya padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:3.20: imāni bhavaṅgāni yadā samaggāni nibbattāni bhavanti so bhavo, taṃ saṃsārassa padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:4.1: titthaññutā pītaññutāya padaṭṭhānaṃ. pitaññutā mattaññutāya padaṭṭhānaṃ. mattaññutā attaññutāya padaṭṭhānaṃ. attaññutā pubbekatapuñāñatāya padaṭṭhānaṃ, pubbekatapuññatā patirūpadesavāsassa padaṭṭhānaṃ. patirūpadesavāso sappurisūpanissayassa padaṭṭhānaṃ. sappurisūpanissayo attasammāpaṇidhānassa padaṭṭhānaṃ. attasammā paṇidhānaṃ sīlānaṃ padaṭṭhānaṃ. sīlāni avippaṭisārassa padaṭṭhānaṃ avippaṭisāro pāmujjassa padaṭṭhānaṃ. pāmujjaṃ pītiyā padaṭṭhānaṃ. pīti passaddhiyā padaṭṭhānaṃ. passaddhi sukhassa padaṭṭhānaṃ. sukhaṃ samādhissa padaṭṭhānaṃ. samādhi yathābhūtañāṇadassanassa padaṭṭhānaṃ. yathābhūta ñāṇadassanaṃ nibbidāya padaṭṭhānaṃ. nibbidā virāgassa padaṭṭhānaṃ. virāgo vimuttiyā padaṭṭhānaṃ.
ne7:4.3: evaṃ yo koci upanissayo yo koci paccayo sabbo so padaṭṭhānaṃ.
